title: Tamsin and the Verdict
author: Ivo Delacroix
blurb: Beatrix Ashgrove, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
